```{python}
import re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

try:
    with open("../../data/gutenberg/mansfield_park.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        mansfield_lines = f.readlines()
    with open("../../data/gutenberg/alice.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        alice_lines = f.readlines()
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Couldn't find a file — check the filename and location.")

## alice text

while not alice_lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
    alice_lines = alice_lines[1:]     # chop off the first line
alice_lines = alice_lines[1:]         # chop off the *** START line itself

while not alice_lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
    alice_lines = alice_lines[:-1]    # chop off the last line
alice_lines = alice_lines[:-1]        # chop off the *** END line itself

alice_text = "".join(alice_lines)

## mansfield park text

while not mansfield_lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
    mansfield_lines = mansfield_lines[1:]     # chop off the first line
mansfield_lines = mansfield_lines[1:]         # chop off the *** START line itself

while not mansfield_lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
    mansfield_lines = mansfield_lines[:-1]    # chop off the last line
mansfield_lines = mansfield_lines[:-1]        # chop off the *** END line itself

mansfield_text = "".join(mansfield_lines)

## cleaning and splitting

alice_words = re.split(r"[\W]+", alice_text.lower())
alice_words = [w for w in alice_words if w != ""]

mansfield_words = re.split(r"[\W]+", mansfield_text.lower())
mansfield_words = [w for w in mansfield_words if w != ""]


## TTR, total

alice_ttr = len(set(alice_words)) / len(alice_words)
mansfield_ttr = len(set(mansfield_words)) / len(mansfield_words)
print("Alice TTR:", alice_ttr)
print("Mansfield Park TTR:", mansfield_ttr)

## TTR, 10000

alice_ttr_10000 = len(set(alice_words[:10000])) / len(alice_words[:10000])
mansfield_ttr_10000 = len(set(mansfield_words[:10000])) / len(mansfield_words[:10000])
print("Alice TTR (10,000 words):", alice_ttr_10000)
print("Mansfield Park TTR (10,000 words):", mansfield_ttr_10000)

## Explore 3: Average 
odyssey_wd_len_total = 0
for w in odyssey_words:
    odyssey_wd_len_total += len(w)
odyssey_avg_word_len = odyssey_wd_len_total / len(odyssey_words)

print("Mansfield Park Average Word Length:", mansfield_avg_word_len)
print("Alice Average Word Length:", alice_avg_word_len)
print("The Odyssey Average Word Length:", odyssey_avg_word_len)

## Plotting it Out

plt.bar(["Lewis Carroll", "Jane Austen", "Homer (tr. Butler)"], [alice_ttr_10000, mansfield_ttr_10000, odyssey_ttr_10000])
plt.title("TTR Comparison: Alice vs Mansfield Park vs The Odyssey")
plt.xlabel("Author")
plt.ylabel("TTR")
plt.show()


```

```{python}

    return len(set(words[:n])) / len(words[:n])
    #sets 10,000 as default parameter to be changed only if specified
    ttr_first(test)       # n is 10000  
    ttr_first(test, 3)    # n is 3
```

```{python}

def avg_word_len(words):
    wd_len_total = 0
    for w in words:
        wd_len_total += len(w)
    word_len = wd_len_total / len(words)
    return word_len

avg_word_len(["a", "bb", "ccc"])
```

```{python}

import re 

def load_words(filename):
    with open("../../../data/gutenberg/" + filename, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    while not lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
        lines = lines[1:]
    lines = lines[1:]

    while not lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
        lines = lines[:-1]
    lines = lines[:-1]

    text = "".join(lines)
    words = re.split(r"[\W]+", text.lower())
    words = [w for w in words if w != ""]
    return words

```

```{python}

alice_words = load_words("alice.txt")
mansfield_words = load_words("mansfield_park.txt")
print(len(alice_words), len(mansfield_words))
```

```{python}
def report(title, words):
    ttr = len(set(words)) / len(words)
    ttr_10000 = len(set(words[:10000])) / len(words[:10000])

    letters = 0
    for w in words:
        letters += len(w)

    print(title, "TTR:", ttr)
    print(title, "TTR (10,000 words):", ttr_10000)
    print(title, "Average Word Length:", letters / len(words))
    return ttr_10000
```

```{python}
import re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def load_words(filename):
    with open("../../data/gutenberg/" + filename, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    while not lines[0].startswith("*** START"):   # chop the header
        lines = lines[1:]
    lines = lines[1:]
    while not lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):    # chop the footer
        lines = lines[:-1]
    lines = lines[:-1]

    text = "".join(lines)
    words = re.split(r"[\W]+", text.lower())
    return [w for w in words if w != ""]

def report(title, words):
    ttr = len(set(words)) / len(words)
    ttr_10000 = len(set(words[:10000])) / len(words[:10000])

    letters = 0
    for w in words:
        letters += len(w)

    print(title, "TTR:", ttr)
    print(title, "TTR (10,000 words):", ttr_10000)
    print(title, "Average Word Length:", letters / len(words))
    return ttr_10000

alice_ttr_10000 = report("Alice", load_words("alice.txt"))
mansfield_ttr_10000 = report("Mansfield Park", load_words("mansfield_park.txt"))
odyssey_ttr_10000 = report("The Odyssey", load_words("odyssey.txt"))

plt.bar(["Lewis Carroll", "Jane Austen", "Homer (tr. Butler)"], [alice_ttr_10000, mansfield_ttr_10000, odyssey_ttr_10000])
plt.title("TTR Comparison: Alice vs Mansfield Park vs The Odyssey")
plt.xlabel("Author")
plt.ylabel("TTR")
plt.show()

```
